message: Reviewer 2 froze re-review b49eaf0d928b4e5fa9b6c7d21e082473 at 096198e2 and marked ChangesRequested, P1. The prior stale ExplicitReviewerYield while claim still held is FIXED. New blocking regression: even with zero claimed reviews (never-claimed or previously resolved), a terminal reviewer session can have a NEWER positively attributed tool call after its recorded yield/end; planner fails to count that live/uncertain session, allowing duplicate UnclaimedFrozenReview. See findings/post-yield-activity-without-claim.md. Add session-level post-end activity suppression independent of claim count, including restart negatives and legitimate later yield/explicit completion. Keep scope narrow; no new infrastructure. Re-run Node/.NET11, freeze new exact review, no deploy/activation.
